title: CloudBase 文档型数据库能力映射

selectedDatabase.evidenceLevel: user-provided DescribeEnvs response interpreted with official resource definitions; user also reported the console as document database

sdk.scope: temporary SP01 transaction probe only; not a formal product adapter decision

documented.writeConflictBehavior: writes lock affected documents; a write-lock conflict can terminate a transaction
documented.operationCountLimit: no fixed count stated; practical limit depends on operation latency and 10-second duration

syntheticProbe.evidenceBoundary: one controlled synthetic probe validates these exact operations and schedule only; it does not prove product business invariants, all conflict schedules, authorization, query phantom behavior, or durability/recovery

indexes.environmentEvidence: no product collection, index, or unique-index enforcement was created or tested in this capability pass

designImplications: protected business writes must be mediated by a server-side Node SDK path; this does not yet define its authentication or authorization adapter
transactional queries must use supported document references; collection where queries are not available inside the documented transaction API
correctness-critical write sets need a concrete addressable document/anchor strategy and transaction schedule before business implementation; pre-checking a query alone is not atomic evidence
keep external provider/network calls outside a retriable transaction and represent durable follow-up separately according to the backend contract
unique indexes are a documented option, but each product key, missing-value strategy, migration, and concurrent duplicate test remains undecided/unverified
stillUnproven: real provider integration and money movement

sources.use: official document database transaction support, server-side/node-sdk restriction, operations, snapshot/write-conflict semantics, 10-second limit, doc-only method limit and external-call warning
official document database index types, unique-index behavior, missing-field-as-null rule and indexed-field size limit
target environment mode identification from user-provided DescribeEnvs response and official resource mapping; historical target environment evidence
exact successful synthetic transaction run and cleanup evidence; not product workload evidence
locked SDK versions used by the temporary probe; file remains outside this commit if untracked
TX01-TX12 and BI01-BI10 require workload-specific physical atomic evidence; query pre-check alone is insufficient
